sentences.text: Akram vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 June, 2024

Author: Ravindra Maithani
Bench: Ravindra Maithani
High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
 First Bail Application No.1092 of 2024
Akram ........Applicant
 Versus
State of Uttarakhand ........Respondent
Present:-
 Mr. Manoj Bhatt and Sachin, Advocates for the applicant.
 Ms. Manisha Rana Singh, Aga for the State.
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J. (Oral)
The applicant is in judicial custody in FIR/Case Crime No.481 of 2023 dated 29.12.2023, under
Section 363, 376 Ipc and Sections 5/6 of The Protection Of Children From Sexual Offences Act,
2012, Police Station Kichha, District Udham Singh Nagar.

entities.text: High Court Of Uttarakhand At Nainital
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He has sought his release on bail.

2. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record.
3. According to the FIR, the victim, a young girl of 16 years, left her house on 28.12.2023 at 08:00 PM, but she did not return.
Suspicion was raised that it is the applicant, who has taken the victim along with him.

4. Learned counsel for the applicant would submit that the applicant is unmarried and of 25 years of age; the applicant and the victim, both were in relationship; they have already married, this is what the victim has stated in her statement under Section 164 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 ("the Code").
5.
The statement of the victim recorded under Section 164 of the Code has been referred to, which has been filed as Annexure No.3 to the bail application.
6. Learned State counsel admits these facts.

7. In the cases of Mahesh Kumar v. State (NCT of Delhi), 2023 SCC OnLine Del 2634, Faizan Wahid Akram vs State Of Uttarakhand on 13 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/118322342/

2023 SCC OnLine Megh 303 and Ashik Ramjali Ansari v. State of Maharashtra and another, 2023 SCC OnLine Bom 1390, the Courts have either granted bail or quashed the proceedings or acquitted the accused in the cases like instant one.
8.

sentences.text: Having considered, this Court is of the view that subject to certain conditions, the applicant may be enlarged on bail.

10. Let the applicant be released on bail, on his executing a personal bond and furnishing two reliable sureties, each of the like amount, to the satisfaction of the Court concerned, subject to the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant or any of his relatives shall not make any contact with the victim, in any manner, whatsoever, either physically, electronically or by any other means.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing the facts to court or any Police Officer and the applicant should not tamper with evidence.
(Ravindra Maithani, J.) 13.06.2024
